headline.title: New plants & capacity expansion marca el ritmo
headline.text: 2 organizaciones anunciaron new plants & capacity expansion en los últimos 30 días, ninguna en los 30 días anteriores; le sigue acquisitions, sales & investments (1).

themes.description: Building new plants, logistics sites and data centres, or expanding existing core facilities to add capacity.
Buying, selling or carving out businesses, taking minority stakes, and managing integration or separation after deals.

stories.title: Europastry will open a cold-chain logistics facility in 2027 at Barcelona City Hub, developed by Goodman on the former Nissan factory grounds
stories.summary: The site is in the Zona Franca district of Barcelona, Catalonia, near the port and Mercabarna. The building covers 8,937 square metres, including 7,403 square metres of storage at -22 ºC and a 1,000 kWp solar plant. The opening is planned for 2027.

host_note.name: Rafael Ruiz
host_note.text: When a food producer invests in a new line, launches a product or enters a new market, packaging decisions made early can have a direct impact on efficiency, launch timing and supply continuity. At LCL, we work alongside our customers from the beginning to develop packaging that is ready for the operation, not adapted to it afterwards.

offers.name: Create packaging for direct-to-consumer growth
offers.title: Protect the product. Strengthen the experience.
offers.claim: Make every delivery another touchpoint for your brand.
points: Formats designed for e-commerce and direct distribution
Flexible production for campaigns, gifting and limited editions
offers.body: LCL develops packaging that combines protection, logistics efficiency and brand experience for e-commerce, subscriptions, gifting and other direct-to-consumer channels.
offers.cta_text: Talk to us about e-commerce packaging

offers.name: Grow your international business
offers.title: Packaging engineered to travel
offers.claim: Protect your products, your brand and your margins as you enter new markets.
points: Protective formats designed for international transport
Packaging optimised for pallet and freight efficiency
Flexible formats for different markets and commercial requirements
offers.body: LCL develops export-ready packaging that protects product integrity from origin to destination while helping optimise space, logistics and presentation across international markets.
offers.cta_text: Talk to us about export packaging

offers.name: Launch and differentiate new products
offers.title: From concept to market with greater flexibility
offers.claim: Give every new product the packaging it needs to stand out, without letting packaging slow the launch.
points: Flexible production for launches, campaigns and new formats
Packaging designed for different products and sales channels
offers.body: LCL combines structural and graphic design with digital printing to develop differentiated packaging for new products, categories and campaigns, from initial launches through to larger production volumes.
offers.cta_text: Talk to us about your next launch

offers.name: Optimise your operations
offers.title: Packaging designed around your production
offers.claim: Make packaging part of the efficiency of your new line from day one.
points: Formats designed around production, packing and palletisation requirements
Packaging engineered to improve operational and logistics efficiency
Safety stock to protect continuity of supply
offers.body: LCL works with your teams to develop packaging formats that integrate with your production and logistics processes, helping reduce unnecessary handling, improve pallet efficiency and support a smooth ramp-up of new capacity.
offers.cta_text: Talk to us about your next line

offers.name: Reduce your packaging impact
offers.title: Sustainability designed into the pack
offers.claim: Turn your packaging into a visible part of your environmental strategy.
points: Packaging designed to optimise material use and logistics
offers.body: LCL develops fibre-based packaging solutions that help food producers reduce environmental impact while maintaining the protection, functionality and performance their supply chains require.

default_offer.body: Desde el diseño estructural y la impresión digital hasta los formatos de exportación, los envases sostenibles y la continuidad del suministro, LCL colabora con los productores alimentarios para convertir el envase en un motor de crecimiento.
